**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** I found no blocker. The side tolerance keeps each real boundary on its own side. The new edge route uses the existing chord proof. The PR is still a draft; its author must flag it ready before a merge.

## What looks good

- The cause is correct. The area and the start side are two offsets. Each flattening of a round join has a radial error of at most 5 um. A side tolerance of 1 um is below that error. The new value of 10 um is twice the error.
- The new pin `machining2d::ring_side::tests::the_side_tolerance_keeps_a_real_short_wall_and_drops_a_flat_sliver` holds both ends. A 0.1 mm stretch that stands 50 um off the start side stays a wall piece. A stretch that stands 5 um off it reads as the start side.
- The pin goes red on a local mutation of `SIDE_EPS` to 1 um. The exact text is below.
- The edge route calls `ring_links::edge_route`, the same function that `level_order` uses. Each of its chords gets `chord_proof`: the certified cutter-centre area, no crossing of `passes` or `st.level`, and each sample in air or over a cut column. `link` checks the total walk against the stay-down limit.
- The route ends. It tries each loop of the certified area, at most `ATTACHES` = 6 attachment points at each end, in two directions.
- `through` only splits a chord at a vertex that already lies on it. It does not move the route.
- Issue #3825 asks for the removal of its `known-fail` marker in this PR. The marker and the `// known-fail-assert` line are gone.
- The changed non-test code has no `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!`. It adds no unchecked index and no unchecked cast. A failed route returns the straight chord's reason, so a lift keeps its named cause.
- The decision file follows `docs/decisions/README.md`. Both `Fixes` lines match the "Expected" text of #3824 and the "Done means" text of #3825.

## Side tolerance proof

I probed `sides` with a temporary test on a rectangular band: the part wall at x = +-10 mm, the stock edge at x = +-(10 + w) mm. I reverted the test.

| Band width | Ring 0 (part wall) | Wall (stock side) |
|---|---|---|
| 5 mm | 1 piece, max x = 10.000 | 1 piece, max x = 15.000 |
| 0.2 mm | 1 piece, max x = 10.000 | 1 piece, max x = 10.200 |
| 50 um | 1 piece, max x = 10.000 | 1 piece, max x = 10.050 |
| 12 um | 1 piece, max x = 10.000 | 1 piece, max x = 10.012 |
| 5 um (below the tolerance) | 2 pieces, max x = 10.005 | 0 pieces |

Each edge takes its own side for every band wider than `SIDE_EPS`. The two offsets can stand up to 5 um from their nominal place, so the split is safe for every band above about 15 um. For a band narrower than that, both edges read as ring 0 and the wall set is empty. That merge changes only the ring order. Each pass stays on the boundary of the certified cutter-centre area. The tool does not move to the other side of the wall, and no gouge follows. The fig8 slivers are 0.117 mm long in a 5 mm band, so the fix reads them as the wall.

## Results (trial merge with main 415440375; built locally)

- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib -- machining2d`: 284 passed, 0 failed, 22 ignored.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test offset_pass_start` (debug): 6 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored (heavy lane).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test flute_reach` (debug): 3 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (heavy lane).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Targeted heavy step (P1, safety floor): `cargo xtask gate heavy --only "app heavy: offset_pass_start"` (release, `--ignored`): ok in 396 s, 8 tests, 0 failed.
- Light lane: `cargo xtask gate light`, release, 6 step(s), 0 failed, 0 stalled, wall 1.1 min. The steps: light build, motion light lib, adaptive_troch_island, adaptive_troch_neck, adaptive_troch_parallel, app light pocket_pass_start.
- Mutation, reverted: `SIDE_EPS` = 1e-2 set to 1e-3. Two new pins went red.
  - `machining2d::ring_side::tests::the_side_tolerance_keeps_a_real_short_wall_and_drops_a_flat_sliver` failed at `crates/motion/src/machining2d/ring_side_tests.rs:181`:

```
a stretch 5 um off the start side reads as the start side: [0.09800000000000164]
```

  - `lifts::fig8_start_sides_lift_only_with_a_named_reason` failed at `crates/app/tests/offset_pass_start/lifts.rs:75`:

```
Inside: 6 lifts inside a level (#3824: at most 0)
```

After the revert, both pins pass again. `git status` is clean.

Author-reported heavy steps, not re-run here: `app heavy: flute_reach`, `app heavy: pocket_pass_start`, `motion heavy: pass_start_levels`. The clamp reading they report moves from 3 to 4 Inside lifts; the test asserts a named reason, not a count, at `crates/motion/tests/pass_start_levels/ring_links.rs:224`.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/ring_side.rs:124` says "the side tolerance of `level_rings` (a micron)". The tolerance is now 10 um. Change "(a micron)" to "(10 um)". `SNAP` stays well below it.
2. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/ring_links.rs:141` adds a route branch that no test reaches with a passing route. The chords use the same proof as the straight chord, so the risk is low. A later test with a passing route would close the gap.
3. `SIDE_EPS` is exactly twice the 5 um flattening error. The worst-case separation equals the tolerance, where the half-open ray rule decides. The new pin covers 50 um and 5 um, not 10 um. State if 10 um is a strict upper bound.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
